items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: On trumpet was, we nicknamed him Platanito, his brother Rabanito, El Guajiro and El Chino. Those were the trumpets.

ctx.x: And what instrument did you play there?

In Tropicana, the bongos. And Rolando Alfonso the conga, Bebo the piano, Guillermo Barreto the drums, the saxophones were Pedro Chao, El Cabito, Roberto, Virgilio, and also the brother of Armandito Romeu, Ruben Romeu. The bass was Fernando Vivar. On trumpet was, we nicknamed him Platanito, his brother Rabanito, El Guajiro and El Chino. Those were the trumpets. (Laughs).
We are already talking about the first stage of the fifties, right?
